held_back_by.text: The provider did not report the billed time.

excluded: Snapshot storage $0.20 / GB-month (the state kept for a sandbox in standby)
Images $0.045 / GB-month (templated deployment images; unknown whether Blaxel's own blaxel/base-image is charged); recorded as image_storage and not counted in a sandbox's cost

Volumes $0.12 / GB-month provisioned, billed "for as long as the volume exists, regardless of how much data you actually write in it" (pricing page); recorded as volume_storage and not counted in a sandbox's cost

Sandbox filesystem: no separate charge. The writable layer is a tmpfs in the sandbox's RAM (about 50% of memory), which the memory rate already bills by allocation; the billing API lists only compute runtime, image storage and snapshot storage as sandbox dimensions. The docs' line that storage is charged while a sandbox is active names no rate and no dimension
Internet egress and internal traffic: Included. No per-creation fee published

Plan: Pay-as-you-go "$0.00+ USAGE". The pricing page lists one memory rate ("$0.0000115 / GB RAM · second") and does not tie it to a tier; the Custom plan is priced by quote ("Contact us for a quote."). Which sizes it needs: Blaxel publishes no per-sandbox size cap by tier (the quotas page says higher tiers unlock 'higher sandbox and volume sizes'); tiers are reached by top-up ($20 / month Tier 1, $50 / month Tier 2, the rest unpublished) or a quota request. Optional add-ons: email support $800 / month + 3% of usage, dedicated support $1,600 / month + 10%, HIPAA $250 / month; custom domains: "Fully-qualified domains" "$0.25 / domain · month" and "Wildcard domains" "$20 / domain · month"; dedicated IPs, egress proxy free during beta
Plan allowance: Up to $200 in free credits (promotional credit does not count toward tier top-ups); Tier 0 is free with 10 sandboxes, Tier 1 needs a $20 / month top-up (50), Tier 2 $50 / month (200)
CPU: bundled with allocated memory; no separate CPU rate is published.
